name: installed_product_status_update_to_repair
description: Verifies that the installed product with ID 42 was updated to repair status for the hardware swap.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM installed_product WHERE installed_product_id = 42 AND account_id = 8 AND product_id = 140 AND serial_number = 'P140-898548-8853' AND status = 'repair';

name: replacement_installed_product_registration
description: Verifies that the replacement installed product RMA-STARK-001 was registered at the same location with in_use status.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM installed_product WHERE installed_product_id = 301 AND account_id = 8 AND product_id = 140 AND location_id = 817 AND serial_number = 'RMA-STARK-001' AND status = 'in_use';

name: case_escalation_critical_priority_update
description: Verifies that customer case 181 was escalated to critical priority with escalation flag and reason set.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 181 AND priority = 'critical' AND escalation = 1 AND escalation_reason = 'impact';

name: case_state_transition_in_progress
description: Verifies that customer case 181 state was transitioned to in_progress.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 181 AND state = 'in_progress';

name: case_assignment_group_update
description: Verifies that customer case 181 was assigned to the Installed Base Support group.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 181 AND assignment_group_id = 10;

name: case_installed_product_reference_update
description: Verifies that customer case 181 now references the replacement installed product instead of the broken unit.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 181 AND installed_product_id = 301 AND product_id = 140;

name: critical_resolution_sla_linkage
description: Verifies that the critical resolution SLA was linked to customer case 181 and is in progress without breach.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_sla WHERE case_sla_id = 2465 AND case_id = 181 AND sla_def_id = 6 AND stage = 'in_progress' AND has_breached = 0;

name: confirmation_email_notification
description: Verifies that a confirmation update notification was successfully sent for customer case 181.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE notification_id = 734 AND case_id = 181 AND email = 'marc.henry@stark-industries.com' AND type = 'update' AND status = 'success';
